Counsel for Appellant :- Nitin Kumar,Arun Kumar Sharma,Mohammad Khalid Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Zafar Ali Hon'ble Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra,J.
Counter affidavit filed by learned A.G.A on behalf of State is taken on record.

Heard learned counsel for the appellant, Shri Arun Kumar, learned counsel for the first informant,
Shri Zafar Ali and learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material on record.
Instant criminal appeal preferred under Section 14(A)(2) against order dated 19.01.2021 passed by Special Judge,SC/ST Act, District- Manipuri in Bail Application No.-130 of 221 arising out of Case Crime No. 188 of 2019 under Sections 323, 328, 342, 376(2)(gha), I.P.C. and 3(2)(V) SC/ST Act,
P.S.- Aunchha District, Mainpur, whereby, learned Trial Court below has rejected the bail application of the appellant by impugned order.

sentences.text: At the outset, learned counsel for the appellant submitted that F.I.R. in present case was lodged by prosecutrix on 24.11.2019 at 09:25 P.M. hours with regard to incident of 24.04.2019.

The said F.I.R.
was lodged on orders of learned Magistrate of application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. filed by the complainant against named accused Munneshah, Saddam, against whom she has levelled allegations of commission of rape in F.I.R.
The named accused persons have misled her to render assistance in search of her missing son, however, she has modified her version at different stages.

sentences.text: 1 The victim in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. had clarified that on the date of incident at around 07:30 P.M., Munnesh and Saddam had committed rape on her and two other persons who were sitting in the car had not committed rape on her.

Munneshah and Saddam are father and son in relation and on that account version of prosecutrix under Section 164 Cr.P.C. is highly improbable inasmuch as the investigation against Munneshah is still pending as he is old and sick person.

Munna Kureshi@Safi Ullah Azam who was also involved in present criminal case has already been enlarged on bail by co-ordinate bench of this Court in Criminal Appeal No. 1044 of 2021 vide order dated 21.12.2021.
However the case of Munneshah is liable to be distinguished with present appellant in some respect, as he has not been assigned specific role.

He further submitted that the victim in her supplementary statement made before Investigation Officer has stated that she is no longer inclined for any further action in the matter as the eyewitness Sharafat Ali had got her lodged the F.I.R. in their own personal interest as there was some in difference between Rizwan @Raju and his wife Nasharin who is sister of accused Saddam.
He lastly submitted that no medical examination of the victim has been conducted after the incident which could lend assurance to prosecution version.
The appellant is held in jail custody since 22.11.2020.
Therefore, he is held in custody for more than 2 and a half years.

Learned Trial Court has rejected bail application of the appellant in mechanical manner without considering the relevant facts involved in the case, therefore, the impugned order is likely to set aside the order and the appellant and may be released on bail.

Learned counsel for first informant raised no objection, however, learned A.G.A. opposed the bail application citing seriousness of the offence and allegations made by the prosecutrix against appellant, however, he did not dispute the factual position raised by learned counsel for the appellant in his contention.

Considering rival submissions of the parties, nature of offence, nature of allegation, complicty of accused, supporting material and the fact that the victim has been inconsistent at different stages with regard to the complicity of the accused persons who are named in F.I.R., without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, a case of bail is made out.
Consequently, the appeal is allowed and the order dated 19.01.2021 is set aside.

Let the appellant- Saddam be released on bail on their furnishing personal bonds with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court concerned with following conditions:-
(i) That the appellant shall cooperate in the expeditious disposal of the trial and shall regularly attend the court unless inevitable.

(ii) That the appellant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) That after his release, the appellant shall not involve in any criminal activity.

sentences.text: 2 (iv) The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by court concerned before the release of the appellant on bail.
It is made clear that in case of breach of any of the conditions mentioned above, court concerned will be at liberty to cancel the bail of the appellant.

It is also made clear that the observations made in this order are limited to the purpose of determination of this bail application and will in no way be construed as an expression on the merits of the case.
On acceptance of bail bonds and personal bonds, the lower court shall transmit Photostat copies thereof to this Court for being kept on the record.
